title: The three tallest mountains
explanation: A tidy table can still hold a wrong number, and a good table can still come with extra chatter. Plating fixes the shape. You still check the facts.
setup: Give me the three tallest mountains on Earth as a table with the columns Mountain and Height in metres. Add nothing else.

sentences.note: K2 is about 8,611 metres. This number was made up, even though it sits neatly in the table.

sentences.text: Hope this helps! Let me know if you want more mountains.
sentences.note: The order said to add nothing else. This extra line is chatter, and it would break a spreadsheet import.
